name: Covenant Coding Sandbox
description: Covenant's public coding agent at sandbox.opencovenant.org. It runs real coding tasks for anyone through a capability-gated, budgeted runtime, and every tool call and file write it brokers is recorded in an append-only, hash-chained audit log. A signed audit-root attestation anchoring that history is published on Solana as MPL Core AppData, so anyone can verify the agent's record through a standard DAS query with no Covenant infrastructure required. Its identity is gated on that audit staying valid: it can only transfer while its audit chain is in policy. Accountable, not just discoverable.
